g95.foundationsBody: Single source of truth: CSS tokens in theme-tokens.css, mirrored in @investhome/ui designTokens / motionTokens. Domain wave CSS may layer density — do not fork brand HEX.
g95.colorRules: Light UI · black/white foundation · restrained gold accent · no neon · status colors only when operational.
g95.buttonUsage: One primary action per section. Preserve width while loading.
g95.buttonDo: Use Button from @investhome/ui with translation keys.
g95.buttonDont: Do not invent one-off button CSS per workspace.
g95.formUsage: Consistent height, labels, focus, validation, TR+EN.
g95.formDo: Use shared Input / Select / SearchInput / DateRangeControl.
g95.formDont: Do not hardcode English placeholders in Turkish mode.
g95.tableUsage: Compact density, sticky header, numeric right-align, shared empty/loading.
g95.tableDo: Compose ui Table + TableToolbar + Pagination (AdminDataTable pattern).
g95.tableDont: Do not fork a third table kit.
g95.filterUsage: Compact filter bar with active count and clear-all.
g95.filterDont: Do not scatter unrelated filter controls without a bar.
g95.cardDo: Prefer MetricCard / Card / WidgetShell with calm padding.
g95.cardDont: No oversized empty cards or heavy shadows.
g95.drawerUsage: Shared shell: Escape, focus trap, sizes sm/md/lg/full.
g95.drawerDo: Use Drawer for record detail; keep footer actions.
g95.drawerDont: Do not invent parallel drawer CSS when ui Drawer fits.
g95.drawerBody: CRM, Investor, Project, Finance, Marketing and AI drawers should behave consistently.
g95.modalUsage: Prefer drawers for records; modals for confirmations.
g95.modalDo: Wrap forms in Dialog with clear primary/secondary actions.
g95.modalBody: Focus trap and Escape are built into Dialog.
g95.navBody: Shell + workspace nav remain permission-aware. Showcase links are demos only.
g95.badgeRules: Same status → same color across workspaces. Never color-only.
g95.alertError: Error explains recovery — no stack traces.
g95.chartRules: Line charts are primary. Sparklines for KPIs. No oversized donuts or 3D.
g95.iconRules: IhIcon only · sizes 12–24 · accessible labels on icon buttons.
g95.a11yBody: WCAG AA where practical: focus rings, keyboard, semantics, status text.
g95.a11yFocus: Visible focus on buttons, inputs, drawer/dialog close.
g95.a11yKeyboard: Escape closes overlays; Tab cycles within focus trap.
g95.a11yContrast: Brand ink on light surfaces; status text + tone.
g95.a11yStatus: aria-live on toasts; role=alert on critical errors.
g95.i18nBody: Turkish is default. Showcase and shared chrome use next-intl keys.
g95.deprecationDoc: See docs/design-system/g95-deprecation-plan.md — do not delete until migrated.
